perks.name: Reflex Action
perks.description: Swapping to a Heat weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon grants a short period of increased handling and accuracy. This effect is extended by dealing damage with that weapon.
perks.exact:
Upon readying a Heat Weapon, Submachine Gun, or Hand Cannon:
Grants Reflex Action for 1.5 seconds.
 Dealing Additional Weapon Damage refreshes the buff duration.

Reflex Action | +50? Handling, 0.6?x Ready Duration Multiplier, and -2.5% Accuracy Cone Size for 1.5 seconds.

perks.name: Hotshot
perks.description: Dealing final blows while Reflex Action is active grants a bonus to weapon stat and increases stability, reload, and aim assist for Heat weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons for a moderate duration.
perks.exact:
While Reflex Action is active:
Scoring a kill grants Hotshot for 10 seconds.
Buff can be refreshed by retriggering Hotshot.

Hotshot | +15? Stability, +20 Reload Speed, and +? Aim Assist for Heat Weapons, Submachine Guns, and Hand Cannons. Additionally, it grants +30 Weapons stat.

archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians who prioritize paracausal attunement.

Primary Stat: Super
Secondary Stat: Melee

item.description: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Health stat.

item.name: Kinetic Scavenger
item.description: Kinetic weapons get bonus reserves when picking up ammo used by that weapon.
item.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.

item.name: Orbs of Restoration
item.description: Picking up an Orb of Power grants a small amount of energy to your ability with the least energy.
item.exact:
On Orb of Power Pickup:

10% | 13% | 15% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability.
Does not grant any Ability Energy to abilities with multiple charges if they have at least 1 charge readied.
